purpose: Zero v1.1 vocabulary and modest retrieval-quality improvement; planning only

accepted_plan_additions.owner_instruction: These look like great ideas, add them to the plan, commit and push
accepted_plan_additions.scope: Included in the plan; no training execution, publication or protected access authorized

data.alias_sampling: Half of the targeted-coverage slots are paired equivalent views: 16 pairs/32 views at batch 256, 8 pairs/16 views at batch 128. Same views, pair IDs and order in every arm; both views count toward the query cap and exposure.
data.alias_admission: Context-valid independently checked equivalences from admitted sources; group source documents, near duplicates and same-intent query/alias-view families before discovery/training; teacher agreement alone is not a label
data.discovery: training partition only; frequency and teacher residual; no audit mining
data.panel_split_unit: source document and near-duplicate query family
data.panel_status: UNBUILT; relevance judgments and source manifest required before quality claims

training.init: M7 p35w-2m-s2500 unfolded checkpoint, lineage verified; new run IDs and optimizer
training.schedule: linear decay; screen and final are separate predeclared schedules
training.positive_bank_policy: All known positives of the selected labeled-query subset fit inside this bank cap; choose eligible query subset before lock, never silently convert a labeled query to query-only
training.candidate_note: Cache has_label and nullable positive_id explicitly. Teacher hits are never relevance labels. Deduplicate in positive/teacher/v1/uniform order, fill deterministically from unused bank IDs. Same bank/lists for all arms; admitted vectors only.

loss_definition.q_t: L2-normalized frozen Stella query vector for raw text with its pinned instruction
loss_definition.q_s: L2-normalized student query from sqrt-count pooling
loss_definition.d: frozen normalized Stella document vectors, stored cache dtype recorded; no retraining or change to document preprocessing
loss_definition.logits: float32 dot(q_t,d)/T and dot(q_s,d)/T using the same T
loss_definition.cosine: mean_queries(1 - dot(q_s,q_t)); no positive-document centroid target
loss_definition.listwise: mean_queries(sum_candidates(p_teacher * (log(p_teacher) - log(p_student)))); stable log_softmax; no extra T squared factor
loss_definition.anchor: mean_squared_deviation of effective folded token rows from their M17 initialization, across rows and dimensions; same definition in all arms
loss_definition.alias: mean_verified_pairs(1 - dot(q_s(view_a), q_s(view_b))); both views retain their own ordinary teacher/candidate targets; no positive-document label is inferred
loss_definition.total: cosine_weight*cosine + enabled_listwise_weight*listwise + init_anchor_weight*anchor + enabled_alias_weight*alias; C/V omit listwise, only VL-A enables alias

training.alias_selection: VL-A must clear the existing simple-arm tie band versus VL on technical nDCG, remain within general dense/fused regression tolerances versus v1, and not worsen the independently judged ambiguous-sense slice versus VL; ties choose VL. This measures alias supervision conditional on expanded vocab and listwise loss, not every combination.

checkpoint_averaging.scope: Each finalist/control full run, each seed; no averaging during short-arm selection
checkpoint_averaging.operation: Equal arithmetic mean of effective float32 folded rows; no separate scalar average, per-row/global rescaling or cross-run/tokenizer averaging; quantize the result once
checkpoint_averaging.snapshot_policy: Keep these step-bound snapshots in addition to time-bound recovery checkpoints; preserve schedule/step identity on resume
checkpoint_averaging.scale_diagnostic: Record effective-table RMS at each checkpoint; same initialization and row units, no data-dependent scale adjustment
checkpoint_averaging.selection: Choose mean_last_three only when its technical nDCG gain over endpoint is positive in each candidate seed and the mean gain exceeds screening_preferences_not_release_bars.simple_arm_tie_band; both seeds must satisfy general dense/fused regression tolerances versus v1 and the ambiguous-sense non-regression versus their endpoint. Otherwise choose endpoint. No window/weight sweep.
checkpoint_averaging.audit_form: Ship seed 0 using the selected form; apply that same form to seed-0 matched control. Freeze both hashes before audit; no audit-driven fallback to the other form. Seed 1 is sensitivity evidence.

int8_resident_loading.implementation_scope: Standalone M17 numpy loader: keep codes/scales resident, gather unique query token IDs, dequantize only gathered rows to float32, preserve sqrt pooling/normalization/fallback/API
int8_resident_loading.comparator: Eager-fp32-row numpy loader on identical selected int8 artifact and tokenizer
int8_resident_loading.measurement: Separate fresh processes for load/steady/peak RSS and cold start; warmed alternating-order repeated latency batches, report p50/p95 of batch latency and throughput by stratum; no ANN or quality reselection
int8_resident_loading.selection: Adopt only if all conformance/fallback/empty/truncation/special-token fixtures pass, steady process RSS is lower, and each stratum's p95 ratio versus eager is <= screening_preferences_not_release_bars.query_p95_latency_ratio_max. Otherwise retain eager loader and record the failed probe.
int8_resident_loading.ports: Verify existing ONNX/FastEmbed parity on the selected artifact; do not infer their memory/latency savings from numpy measurements or redesign their runtimes

allocation_hours.phase: bounded driver/loader design, data manifests, tokenizer and real smoke, reviews
coverage and verified alias pairs, teacher targets and candidate cache
five matched short screen arms and selection
candidate/control full runs, seed replication and fixed endpoint/averaged-form selection
locked audit and exact dense/fused evaluation
int8 resident/eager loader comparison, numpy/ONNX parity and serving costs

budget_policy.before_lock: Measure complete pipeline stages at two sizes; reduce draft dose/batch and re-budget before quality observations if needed
budget_policy.after_lock: Honor phase ceilings; incomplete required phase stops dependent work, with checkpointed recovery only inside remaining reserve; no silent dose/seed/arm cuts
budget_policy.screen_overrun: No selection from an accidentally incomplete matrix; report incomplete screen and stop unless all registered arms complete within the existing reserve
budget_policy.unused_time: May move forward to the same registered work, never a new hypothesis; hard total remains 72h

execution_entry_missing: owner ratification of the prospective M17 protocol and any new release criteria; this plan changes no historical bar
admitted input/cache identities, document-group splits, new-token support audit and judged M17 panel manifest
real pipeline throughput at two sizes and a schedule fitting the allocation; synthetic P0 is not that forecast
training implementation and smoke/resume validation, reviewed independently twice before expensive execution
